description: This Zenodo dataset from Eindhoven University of Technology holds pedestrian trajectories measured on platform 2 of Eindhoven Centraal station in the Netherlands, which serves tracks 3 and 4. Each pedestrian on the platform is tracked at 10 frames per second, and each record gives the time since the start of measurement in milliseconds, an object identifier and x and y positions in millimetres. The data cover 60 consecutive days in six Parquet files of ten days each, about 4.6 GB in total, with an overhead image of the platform. Coverage: one station platform in Eindhoven. Access: Parquet files on Zenodo, published 2024-09-18. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: exact dates and times were removed for privacy; the series starts at an unknown time shortly after midnight on a random date between 1 April and 1 May 2022, so it cannot be matched to timetables. Simulation uses are fitting and validating pedestrian models of crowding, platform capacity and boarding flows, and testing crowd simulators against measured movement. Related records: the physics-based pedestrian modelling package, which is built to process this dataset.
